sentences.zh: 在那之后，巴西队在超过50年的时间里，没有再选拔过黑人守门员在世界杯首发。

sentences.en: And this wasn't a coincidence.
sentences.zh: 这绝非巧合。

sentences.en: After that game, black goalkeepers were regarded as less reliable than white ones in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 那场比赛后，在巴西，黑人守门员被认为不如白人守门员可靠。

sentences.en: Which is disgusting.
sentences.zh: 这真是令人作呕。

sentences.en: But Barbosa wasn't the only focus of Brazilian blame.
sentences.zh: 但巴博萨并不是巴西人指责的唯一焦点。

sentences.en: In fact, everything about Brazilian soccer was scrutinized, down to the uniforms the players were wearing.
sentences.zh: 事实上，关于巴西足球的一切都受到了审视，甚至连球员穿的球衣也不例外。

sentences.en: The authorities thought that the white shirt was cursed.
sentences.zh: 当局认为那件白色球衣被诅咒了。

sentences.en: And I think everybody else in Brazil did.
sentences.zh: 我想巴西的其他所有人也都是这么想的。

sentences.en: And above all, there was the determination never to play in white shirts again.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，他们下定决心再也不穿白色球衣了。

sentences.en: It was pretty unusual for a team to completely transform their uniform.
sentences.zh: 对于一支球队来说，彻底更换球衣是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: Most countries have played in the same colors since the first World Cup back in the early 20th century.
sentences.zh: 大多数国家自20世纪初第一届世界杯以来，一直穿着相同颜色的球衣。

sentences.en: But the Brazilians decided their uniform was a problem.
sentences.zh: 但巴西人认定他们的球衣是个问题。

sentences.en: So in 1953, the Brazilian soccer authorities set up a competition and advertised it in a national newspaper that's distributed all over Brazil.
sentences.zh: 因此在1953年，巴西足球当局举办了一场比赛，并在全国发行的报纸上刊登了广告。

sentences.en: They wanted people to write in with their designs for a new uniform.
sentences.zh: 他们希望人们写信寄来他们设计的新球衣方案。

sentences.en: The contest had only one stipulation.
sentences.zh: 比赛只有一个规定。

sentences.en: The color of the uniform had to include all the colors of the Brazilian flag.
sentences.zh: 球衣的颜色必须包含巴西国旗上的所有颜色。

sentences.en: Green, blue, white and yellow.
sentences.zh: 绿色、蓝色、白色和黄色。

sentences.en: A design that would truly represent Brazil.
sentences.zh: 一个能真正代表巴西的设计。

sentences.en: Hundreds of people entered the contest, including this guy.
sentences.zh: 数百人参加了这次比赛，其中包括这个人。

sentences.en: My name is Aldir Garcia Schley, and I'm from Jaguarão, on the border with Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 我叫阿尔迪尔·加西亚·施莱，来自与乌拉圭接壤的雅瓜朗。

sentences.en: Aldir Garcia Schley.
sentences.zh: 阿尔迪尔·加西亚·施莱。

sentences.en: He was just 19 when he entered the competition.
sentences.zh: 他参加比赛时年仅19岁。

sentences.en: A young man who had grown up in a little town right on the border between Brazil and Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 一个在巴西和乌拉圭边境小镇长大的年轻人。

sentences.en: Schley wasn't a designer.
sentences.zh: 施莱并不是一名设计师。

sentences.en: He was working at a local newspaper as an illustrator.
sentences.zh: 他在当地一家报社担任插画师。

sentences.en: He says when he first heard about the competition, he thought it would be too difficult.
sentences.zh: 他说，当他第一次听说这个比赛时，觉得太难了。

sentences.en: Yeah, the first impression I had was that this was foolish.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的第一印象是这很愚蠢。

sentences.en: That was ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 那太荒谬了。

sentences.en: Because it's rare to have a team with four colors.
sentences.zh: 因为拥有一种包含四种颜色的球衣是很罕见的。

sentences.en: Working four colors into just the shirt would have been hard.
sentences.zh: 要把四种颜色融入一件球衣会很困难。

sentences.en: But eventually, Schley realized he could use the whole uniform to spread out the colors.
sentences.zh: 但最终，施莱意识到他可以利用整套球衣来分布这些颜色。

sentences.en: He tried blue shorts with a green shirt, a yellow and green striped shirt with white shorts,
sentences.zh: 他尝试了蓝色短裤配绿色球衣，黄绿条纹球衣配白色短裤，

sentences.en: a green and yellow striped shirt with blue shorts.
sentences.zh: 还有绿黄条纹球衣配蓝色短裤。

sentences.en: He came up with over 200 different designs.
sentences.zh: 他想出了200多种不同的设计。

sentences.en: Until eventually, he had it.
sentences.zh: 直到最后，他成功了。

sentences.en: Blue shorts, white socks, and a yellow shirt with green trim around the neck and the sleeves.
sentences.zh: 蓝色短裤，白色球袜，黄色球衣，领口和袖口有绿色镶边。

sentences.en: He sent the design off and a few weeks later,
sentences.zh: 他寄出了设计稿，几周后，

sentences.en: he looked down at the newspaper and saw his design staring back at him.
sentences.zh: 他低头看报纸，看到了自己的设计出现在上面。

sentences.en: He had won.
sentences.zh: 他赢了。

sentences.en: After there, it was just a party.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，简直就是一场狂欢。

sentences.en: My feet didn't touch the ground, and I was celebrating in the newsroom where I worked.
sentences.zh: 我感觉脚不着地，在工作的报社里庆祝着。

sentences.en: It was like something impossible had just happened.
sentences.zh: 就像发生了什么不可能的事情一样。

sentences.en: After he won, Schley got to bask in the glory of it all for a while.
sentences.zh: 获奖后，施莱享受了一段时间的荣耀。

sentences.en: He went to Rio, did an internship with the newspaper that had sponsored the conteSt.
sentences.zh: 他去了里约，在赞助比赛的报社实习。

sentences.en: He even lived with the Brazilian players for a few months.
sentences.zh: 他甚至和巴西球员一起生活了几个月。

sentences.en: But eventually, he returned to his small town and kind of forgot about the shirt for a while.
sentences.zh: 但最终，他回到了家乡小镇，渐渐淡忘了那件球衣的事。

sentences.en: But pretty soon, the shirt was Brazil.
sentences.zh: 但很快，这件球衣就成了巴西的象征。

sentences.en: In 1962, the Brazilians won the World Cup in Chile, and they were wearing Schley's uniform.
sentences.zh: 1962年，巴西队在智利赢得了世界杯，他们穿的就是施莱设计的球衣。

sentences.en: Players like Pele wore the yellow shirt and dazzled the world with their extraordinary skill and beauty.
sentences.zh: 像贝利这样的球员穿着黄色球衣，以他们非凡的技巧和美感令世界惊叹。

sentences.en: Then color TV comes along, and the whole world can watch Brazil in brand new technicolor,
sentences.zh: 后来彩色电视出现了，全世界都能以全新的色彩观看巴西队的比赛，

sentences.en: like in the 1970 World Cup in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 比如1970年在墨西哥举行的世界杯。

sentences.en: I was five when the 1970 World Cup was played, and I saw Brazil win the 70 World Cup in shimmering yellow shirts.
sentences.zh: 1970年世界杯举行时我五岁，我看着巴西队穿着闪耀的黄色球衣赢得了那届世界杯。

sentences.en: Here's soccer historian David Goldblatt again.
sentences.zh: 这是足球历史学家大卫·戈德布拉特。

sentences.en: For me, you know, there's a memory there that I think lots of people have, even if they didn't see it,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，你知道，那是一种很多人都有的记忆，即使他们当时没亲眼看到，

sentences.en: of, you know, of dazzle, of brilliance, of amazing sort of global south sunshine, of flair.
sentences.zh: 那是一种耀眼、辉煌、令人惊叹的全球南方阳光，一种天赋。

sentences.en: Where Brazil had failed in 1950, the following years saw success after success.
sentences.zh: 巴西在1950年失败了，但随后的几年里，他们接连取得成功。

sentences.en: They won World Cup after World Cup,
sentences.zh: 他们赢了一届又一届世界杯，

sentences.en: Their yellow shirts becoming as much a hallmark as their intricate footwork and dazzling play.
sentences.zh: 他们的黄色球衣变得和他们复杂的脚法与炫目的比赛一样，成为了标志。

sentences.en: Schley's design became iconic, a symbol of Brazil, full of sun and life.
sentences.zh: 施莱的设计成为了标志性的符号，一个充满阳光和生命力的巴西象征。

sentences.en: But for Schley, life wasn't quite living up to the image of Brazil he had created.
sentences.zh: 但对施莱来说，现实生活并没有达到他所创造的巴西形象那样美好。

sentences.en: He started working as a writer and academic.
sentences.zh: 他开始从事写作和学术工作。

sentences.en: And in 1964, a brutal U.S.-backed military dictatorship took power in a coup.
sentences.zh: 1964年，一个残酷的、由美国支持的军事独裁政权通过政变夺取了政权。

sentences.en: Anti-Goulart demonstrations that greeted the now-deposed Brazilian president at Miami airport...
sentences.zh: 在迈阿密机场迎接现已被罢免的巴西总统的反古拉特示威活动……

sentences.en: The new military government cracked down on people it considered to be subversive, including academics.
sentences.zh: 新的军政府对他们认为具有颠覆性的人进行了镇压，包括学者。

sentences.en: Like a lot of other professors and students, Schley was arrested for basically being on the political left.
sentences.zh: 像许多其他教授和学生一样，施莱因为基本上属于政治左派而被捕。

sentences.en: When he got out of jail, he was expelled from his teaching job and was banned from leaving the country.
sentences.zh: 出狱后，他被开除了教职，并被禁止离开该国。

sentences.en: The dictatorship lasted for about 20 years.
sentences.zh: 独裁统治持续了大约20年。

sentences.en: But despite the difficulties of living under the watchful eye of the military police,
sentences.zh: 但尽管在军警的监视下生活困难重重，

sentences.en: Schley became a successful writer, and he developed an academic specialty.
sentences.zh: 施莱还是成为了一名成功的作家，并发展出了自己的学术专长。

sentences.en: Schley has spent his life writing about the border between Brazil and Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 施莱一生都在书写关于巴西和乌拉圭边境的内容。

sentences.en: Schley was technically born in Brazil, but less than a mile from the border with Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 施莱严格来说出生在巴西，但距离乌拉圭边境不到一英里。

sentences.en: In fact, when he was a kid, his father helped build a bridge across the river that separates Uruguay from Brazil.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他小时候，他父亲曾帮助建造了一座横跨巴西和乌拉圭界河的桥梁。

sentences.en: Schley's experience growing up between two countries and his experiences under military rule have helped shape his feelings about Brazilian nationalism.
sentences.zh: 施莱在两国之间长大的经历以及他在军事统治下的经历，塑造了他对巴西民族主义的感受。

sentences.en: Even though he designed a shirt that could be considered more patriotic than the Brazilian flag,
sentences.zh: 尽管他设计了一件被认为比巴西国旗更具爱国意义的球衣，

sentences.en: he's actually very wary of patriotism.
sentences.zh: 但他实际上对爱国主义非常警惕。

sentences.en: It is an idea that competes with the ones that I have, to live without limits, live without borders.
sentences.zh: 这是一种与我所持有的理念相冲突的想法，即无限制地生活，无国界地生活。

sentences.en: Schley may not be a Brazilian patriot, but the soccer fan in him can't help but be proud of the Brazilian team.
sentences.zh: 施莱可能不是一个巴西爱国者，但他心中的球迷情结让他无法不对巴西队感到自豪。

sentences.en: Brazil won the championship five times.
sentences.zh: 巴西队赢得了五次冠军。

sentences.en: This is a source of pride.
sentences.zh: 这是自豪感的来源。

sentences.en: It's an honour for all of us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们所有人来说都是一种荣誉。

sentences.en: But Schley has a secret, or at least something he never used to share with people who knew he was the designer of the famous yellow shirt.
sentences.zh: 但施莱有一个秘密，或者至少是他以前从未与那些知道他是著名黄色球衣设计师的人分享过的事情。

sentences.en: Schley roots for Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 施莱支持乌拉圭队。

sentences.en: For many in Brazil, this is blasphemy, but not for him.
sentences.zh: 对于许多巴西人来说，这是亵渎，但对他来说不是。

sentences.en: We are one people, one border community.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个民族，一个边境社区。

sentences.en: Even if you have two languages, the people have only one cultural identity.
sentences.zh: 即使你有两种语言，人民也只有一种文化认同。

sentences.en: Schley feels culturally connected to both Brazil and Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 施莱在文化上对巴西和乌拉圭都有归属感。

sentences.en: But he ultimately had to pick one country's team to root for.
sentences.zh: 但他最终必须选择支持一个国家的球队。

sentences.en: So, these days, when Brazil plays Uruguay, Schley, like a lot of other soccer fans, suits up in his favourite jersey.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些天当巴西对阵乌拉圭时，施莱像许多其他球迷一样，穿上了他最喜欢的球衣。

sentences.en: But not the yellow shirt he designed, a sky blue one, the colour of Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 但不是他设计的黄色球衣，而是一件天蓝色的，那是乌拉圭的颜色。

sentences.en: Then, he crosses the border from Brazil to Uruguay and finds some quiet bar to watch the game.
sentences.zh: 然后，他越过边境从巴西来到乌拉圭，找一家安静的酒吧看比赛。

sentences.en: After the break, we get a critical update from Emmett about the rollercoaster the yellow jersey has been on since we first aired that story.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我们将从埃米特那里得到一个重要更新，关于自我们首次播出那个故事以来，黄色球衣所经历的过山车式变化。

sentences.en: Okay, so I'm here with producer Emmett Fitzgerald, who is going to give us an update on the state of the Brazilian soccer jersey and what's happened since 2017.
sentences.zh: 好的，我和制片人埃米特·菲茨杰拉德在一起，他将为我们更新巴西足球球衣的现状，以及自2017年以来发生的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah, a lot has happened to the Brazil soccer jersey since we first aired that episode.
sentences.zh: 是的，自我们首次播出那一集以来，巴西足球球衣发生了很多变化。

sentences.en: It was really interesting to me, listening back to the story, that the designer of the jersey, Schley, was someone who was really wary of nationalism,
sentences.zh: 回听这个故事，我感到非常有趣的是，球衣的设计者施莱是一个非常警惕民族主义的人，

sentences.en: especially given what has just happened in Brazil on January 8th.
sentences.zh: 特别是考虑到1月8日在巴西刚刚发生的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah, and just to recap, on January 8th, thousands of far-right nationalists descended on the capital city of Brasilia to protest the inauguration of Lula, Brazil's new president.
sentences.zh: 是的，简单回顾一下，1月8日，成千上万的极右翼民族主义者涌入首都巴西利亚，抗议巴西新总统卢拉的就职典礼。

sentences.en: Chaos in Brazil, as thousands stormed the country's capital, protesting October's election results.
sentences.zh: 巴西陷入混乱，数千人冲击了该国首都，抗议10月份的选举结果。

sentences.en: Supporters of far-right former...
sentences.zh: 极右翼前任的支持者们……

sentences.en: The mob attacked Congress, the Supreme Court, and the palace of the president.
sentences.zh: 暴徒袭击了国会、最高法院和总统府。

sentences.en: And it all just felt really eerily similar to what happened two years ago in the United States on January 6th.
sentences.zh: 这一切感觉与两年前美国1月6日发生的事情惊人地相似。

sentences.en: Like a full-on insurrection by right-wing extremists questioning the results of the legitimate presidential election.
sentences.zh: 就像是一场由右翼极端分子发起的全面暴乱，质疑合法总统选举的结果。

sentences.en: Yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全是这样。

sentences.en: It felt disturbingly familiar from an American perspective.
sentences.zh: 从美国的角度来看，这感觉令人不安地熟悉。

sentences.en: But if you look at videos or images from the Brazilian insurrection, you can't help but notice what the rioters are wearing.
sentences.zh: 但如果你看巴西暴乱的视频或图片，你会不由自主地注意到暴徒们穿的是什么。

sentences.en: The rioters, many dressed in green and yellow, the colors of the Brazilian flag, smashed windows, ransacked offices, even set fire to a carpet inside...
sentences.zh: 暴徒们，许多人穿着巴西国旗颜色的绿黄色衣服，砸碎窗户，洗劫办公室，甚至点燃了里面的地毯……

sentences.en: Yeah, so many of them are wearing the yellow jersey of the national soccer team.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们中的许多人穿着国家足球队的黄色球衣。

sentences.en: It isn't just the colors of the flag, like it's the actual soccer team jersey.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是国旗的颜色，而是真正的国家队球衣。

sentences.en: And I mean, watching these videos, it feels like the jersey has fully become a symbol of the far-right,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看着这些视频，感觉这件球衣已经完全成为了极右翼的象征，

sentences.en: which is a pretty different situation from what we described in the original piece.
sentences.zh: 这与我们在最初的报道中所描述的情况大不相同。

sentences.en: Yeah, so in the episode that we just played, you heard from Brazilian soccer journalist Fernando Duarte.
sentences.zh: 是的，在我们刚刚播放的那一集中，你听到了巴西足球记者费尔南多·杜阿尔特的讲述。

sentences.en: And Fernando describes the Brazilian soccer jersey as this great unifier.
sentences.zh: 费尔南多将巴西足球球衣描述为一种伟大的统一力量。

sentences.en: For better or worse, it was the symbol of this beautiful game that united what had long been a deeply unequal and divided country.
sentences.zh: 无论好坏，它曾是这项美丽运动的象征，团结了一个长期以来极度不平等和分裂的国家。

sentences.en: So what happened to the shirt?
sentences.zh: 那么这件球衣发生了什么？

sentences.en: Like, how did it get from there to here?
sentences.zh: 它是如何从那时变成现在的样子的？

sentences.en: Well, I think we got to start with the 2018 presidential election.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为我们必须从2018年的总统选举说起。

sentences.en: Right, what happened after the 2018 presidential election is that one side of the political spectrum claimed the shirt.
sentences.zh: 没错，2018年总统选举后发生的事情是，政治光谱的一方占有了这件球衣。

sentences.en: This is Fernando Duarte again, and he says that after that election, the far-right really latched on to the shirt as their own political symbol.
sentences.zh: 这是费尔南多·杜阿尔特，他说在那次选举后，极右翼确实将这件球衣作为他们自己的政治象征。

sentences.en: It became a symbol of whoever supported the far-right president Jair Bolsonaro.
sentences.zh: 它成为了任何支持极右翼总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗的人的象征。

sentences.en: He's known as Brazil's Donald Trump, an anti-establishment politician who promises to drain the swamp and crack down on crime.
sentences.zh: 他被称为巴西的唐纳德·特朗普，一位反建制的政治家，承诺清理沼泽并打击犯罪。

sentences.en: This is CNN coverage from election night in 2018 when Jair Bolsonaro was elected.
sentences.zh: 这是2018年选举之夜雅伊尔·博索纳罗当选时CNN的报道。

sentences.en: And if you look in videos of crowds on that election night, you'll see a lot of Brazilian flags,
sentences.zh: 如果你看选举之夜人群的视频，你会看到很多巴西国旗，

sentences.en: and you will see a lot of people wearing the colors of the Brazilian flag, yellow and green.
sentences.zh: 你会看到很多人穿着巴西国旗的颜色，黄色和绿色。

sentences.en: Wearing national symbols, national colors, yellow and green, became something of a badge of identification of the president's supporters.
sentences.zh: 穿着国家象征、国家颜色，黄色和绿色，成为了一种总统支持者的身份徽章。

sentences.en: And obviously, what is more yellow and green?
sentences.zh: 显然，还有什么比黄色和绿色更具代表性？

sentences.en: What is more representative of Brazil as a nation than the national team shirt?
sentences.zh: 还有什么比国家队球衣更能代表巴西这个国家？

sentences.en: Now, I want to be really clear that the roots of this connection between the jersey and the far-right go back before Bolsonaro.
sentences.zh: 现在，我想明确一点，球衣与极右翼之间这种联系的根源可以追溯到博索纳罗之前。

sentences.en: In the 60s and 70s and 80s, the military dictatorship in Brazil used the success of the national team
sentences.zh: 在60年代、70年代和80年代，巴西的军事独裁政权利用国家队在赛场上穿着黄色球衣取得的成功，

sentences.en: wearing those yellow jerseys on the pitch to cultivate a sense of nationalism and support for the regime.
sentences.zh: 来培养一种民族主义情绪和对政权的支持。

sentences.en: And even more recently, the far-right adopted the yellow and green during the impeachment of former President Dilma Rousseff in 2016.
sentences.zh: 甚至在最近，极右翼在2016年弹劾前总统迪尔玛·罗塞夫期间也采用了黄色和绿色。

sentences.en: But when Bolsonaro gets into power, this whole thing really escalates, in part because he starts to wear the jersey himself.
sentences.zh: 但当博索纳罗上台后，这一切真的升级了，部分原因是他自己开始穿这件球衣。

sentences.en: Intentionally, it wasn't an accident.
sentences.zh: 这是故意的，并非偶然。

sentences.en: The president intentionally simulated wearing the national team shirt as a sign of true patriotism, of true love to the nation.
sentences.zh: 总统有意模拟穿着国家队球衣，作为真正爱国主义、对国家真正热爱的标志。

sentences.en: And obviously, love to the nation in the small print was basically support for his agenda.
sentences.zh: 显然，对国家的热爱在细则中基本上就是对他议程的支持。

sentences.en: And as you can imagine, this created a real dilemma for a lot of soccer fans in Brazil who were used to wearing that jersey.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，这对许多习惯穿那件球衣的巴西足球迷来说，确实造成了真正的困境。

sentences.en: I always joked that I looked great in yellow as well.
sentences.zh: 我总是开玩笑说，我穿黄色也很好看。

sentences.en: So it was always something that I enjoyed doing.
sentences.zh: 所以这一直是我乐于做的事情。

sentences.en: This is Julia Belastrindadji.
sentences.zh: 这是朱莉娅·贝拉斯特林达吉。
zh_words: 朱莉娅·贝拉斯特林达吉

sentences.en: She's a sports journalist from Brazil who's currently getting a PhD in the UK.
sentences.zh: 她是一位来自巴西的体育记者，目前正在英国攻读博士学位。

sentences.en: She says that growing up, she always wore the yellow shirt, especially during World Cups.
sentences.zh: 她说她从小就一直穿那件黄色球衣，尤其是在世界杯期间。

sentences.en: But she stopped during the Bolsonaro presidency because she didn't want to send the wrong signals.
sentences.zh: 但在博索纳罗担任总统期间，她停止了穿这件球衣，因为她不想发出错误的信号。

sentences.en: For me, it was kind of, OK, I don't want to be seen as something that I'm not.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这有点像是，好吧，我不想被看作是我本来不是的那种人。

sentences.en: I don't want to be seen as Bolsonaroista.
sentences.zh: 我不想被看作是博索纳罗的支持者。

sentences.en: I mean, not to take the Trump analogy too much further, but it feels like a kind of like the red hat thing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，并不是想把特朗普的类比推得太远，但这感觉就像是那种红帽子事件。

sentences.en: Like there's a piece of clothing that, for all intents and purposes, is pretty neutral, immediately became an identifier of your political beliefs.
sentences.zh: 就像有一件衣服，无论从什么角度看，它本来是相当中性的，却突然变成了你政治信仰的标识。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it is a lot like that, except, you know, instead of a sort of random piece of clothing like a red hat,
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得确实很像，只不过，你知道，它不是像红帽子那样随意的衣服，

sentences.en: it's like the most famous and beloved piece of clothing in the country.
sentences.zh: 它是这个国家最著名、最受喜爱的衣服。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: You know, I think for the past four years, for a lot of Brazilians, it's felt as though this famous yellow jersey has been symbolically hijacked by the far right.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为在过去四年里，对许多巴西人来说，这件著名的黄色球衣在象征意义上似乎被极右翼劫持了。

sentences.en: But there were two events this past year that really started to turn things around.
sentences.zh: 但过去一年里发生了两件事，真正开始扭转局面。

sentences.en: And the first was that Bolsonaro lost the presidential election to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, better known as just Lula.
sentences.zh: 第一件事是博索纳罗在总统选举中输给了路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦，也就是大家熟知的卢拉。
zh_words: 路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦

sentences.en: He was the former president of Brazil and a champion of the Brazilian left, the Brazilian labor movement.
sentences.zh: 他是巴西前总统，也是巴西左翼和劳工运动的领袖。

sentences.en: And when he wins, Lula immediately makes a point of trying to reclaim the jersey.
sentences.zh: 当他获胜后，卢拉立即明确表示要尝试夺回这件球衣的象征权。

sentences.en: He posted a lot of pictures wearing the jersey after the election, like whenever Brazilians would play, he would post pictures of him wearing the jersey.
sentences.zh: 选举后他发布了很多穿这件球衣的照片，比如每当巴西队比赛时，他都会发布自己穿这件球衣的照片。

sentences.en: Just after the election, Lula was quoted saying, we can't be ashamed of wearing our green and yellow shirt.
sentences.zh: 就在选举后，卢拉曾说，我们不能因为穿上我们的绿黄色球衣而感到羞耻。

sentences.en: It doesn't belong to one particular candidate.
sentences.zh: 它不属于某个特定的候选人。

sentences.en: It doesn't belong to one particular party.
sentences.zh: 它不属于某个特定的政党。

sentences.en: Green and yellow are the colors of 213 million citizens who love this country.
sentences.zh: 绿色和黄色是2.13亿热爱这个国家公民的颜色。

sentences.en: So this reclamation is like overt.
sentences.zh: 所以这种夺回象征权的行为是非常公开的。

sentences.en: It isn't like subtle at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不含蓄。

sentences.en: Like he's really speaking to the issue.
sentences.zh: 他确实是在直面这个问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was this really intentional effort to sort of neutralize the jersey, to make it for everyone again.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一种非常刻意的努力，旨在中和这件球衣的政治色彩，让它重新属于所有人。

sentences.en: And it was all happening in advance of event number two, which is the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都发生在第二件事——世界杯——之前。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So we just had the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 所以我们刚刚经历了世界杯。

sentences.en: Congrats to our Argentinian colleague, Martin, who was very invested in the series.
sentences.zh: 祝贺我们的阿根廷同事马丁，他非常投入地关注了这次比赛。

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: Congrats, Martin.
sentences.zh: 祝贺你，马丁。

sentences.en: And, you know, Argentina's great rivals, Brazil, ended up bowing out pretty early with a disappointing loss to Croatia.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，阿根廷的劲敌巴西队，最终在输给克罗地亚队后很早就出局了，令人失望。

sentences.en: But in the early stages of the tournament, they really were performing very well.
sentences.zh: 但在比赛的早期阶段，他们的表现确实非常好。

sentences.en: And, you know, going into the tournament, a lot of people on the left had kind of abandoned the national team, in part because of the associations with the jersey,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在进入比赛时，许多左翼人士已经放弃了国家队，部分原因是它与这件球衣的关联，

sentences.en: but also because a lot of the players were big Bolsonaro supporters, particularly the star Neymar.
sentences.zh: 但也因为许多球员是博索纳罗的坚定支持者，尤其是球星内马尔。

sentences.en: But during those early games, president-elect Lula was very publicly watching and cheering the team on.
sentences.zh: 但在那些早期比赛中，当选总统卢拉非常公开地观看并为球队加油。

sentences.en: He was celebrating.
sentences.zh: 他在庆祝。

sentences.en: He was posting videos, watching the game, celebrating the goals, always with the jersey.
sentences.zh: 他发布视频，观看比赛，庆祝进球，而且总是穿着那件球衣。

sentences.en: Even if the people who are watching with him wearing suits and, you know, politicians, he always feels like he has to show he is a man of the people.
sentences.zh: 即使和他一起看球的人都穿着西装，你知道，都是政客，他总是觉得他必须表现出他是人民的一员。

sentences.en: And a man of the people in Brazil watches football and sports the national team.
sentences.zh: 而在巴西，人民的一员会看足球并支持国家队。

sentences.en: So, right.
sentences.zh: 所以，没错。

sentences.en: You can't be a man of the people in Brazil and not support the national team.
sentences.zh: 在巴西，你不可能成为人民的一员却不支持国家队。

sentences.en: So how well did this work, this sort of intentional reclamation?
sentences.zh: 那么这种刻意的夺回象征权的做法效果如何呢？

sentences.en: Did Brazilian soccer fans start embracing the jersey again without, you know, necessarily signaling their, you know, their political leanings?
sentences.zh: 巴西球迷是否开始重新拥抱这件球衣，而不再必然地暗示他们的政治倾向了呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think for a while there was a feeling like it was working.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得有一段时间确实感觉奏效了。

sentences.en: You know, the timing of Lula's election with Brazil's play at the World Cup,
sentences.zh: 你知道，卢拉当选的时间点与巴西在世界杯上的表现重合，

sentences.en: it gave this feeling of a sort of symbolic reset during those early games when Brazil was destroying teams like South Korea and, you know,
sentences.zh: 在巴西队摧毁韩国队等球队的早期比赛中，这给人一种象征性重置的感觉，而且，你知道，

sentences.en: doing their samba dances after every goal in the yellow jersey.
sentences.zh: 他们在每次进球后都穿着黄色球衣跳桑巴舞。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people got excited and felt sort of like things were back to normal, including Fernando.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人都很兴奋，感觉一切都恢复正常了，包括费尔南多。

sentences.en: Fernando, the Korea game I was watching, I got so excited, I bought a new shirt.
sentences.zh: 费尔南多，我在看韩国那场比赛时，我太兴奋了，我买了一件新球衣。

sentences.en: You did?
sentences.zh: 你买了？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I just got really excited.
sentences.zh: 我只是太兴奋了。

sentences.en: I said, well, maybe it's time to buy a shirt again.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，也许是时候再买一件球衣了。

sentences.en: Maybe when I go running, I'm going to wear it again.
sentences.zh: 也许当我跑步时，我会再穿上它。

sentences.en: It was, as a football fan, I was really, really, really enchanted by the brand of football that they played.
sentences.zh: 作为一名足球迷，我真的、真的、真的被他们踢出的足球风格所吸引。

sentences.en: And it's the shirt of my country.
sentences.zh: 这是我国家的球衣。

sentences.en: I think I'm entitled to wear it as a Brazilian.
sentences.zh: 作为一名巴西人，我认为我有权穿上它。

sentences.en: So, this interview that I did with Fernando happened while the World Cup was still going on.
sentences.zh: 所以，我和费尔南多的这次采访是在世界杯还在进行时进行的。

sentences.en: And I think at that point, he and a lot of people were feeling cautiously optimistic, you know, about the team, about the country, about the jersey.
sentences.zh: 我想在那时，他和许多人对球队、对国家、对这件球衣都感到谨慎乐观。

sentences.en: It felt like for the first time in a while,
sentences.zh: 感觉好像是久违的第一次，

sentences.en: he could maybe wear a yellow jersey out in the world when he goes for his run and not feel like that was going to identify him as a Bolsonaro supporter.
sentences.zh: 他也许可以在外出跑步时穿上黄色球衣，而不必担心这会被人认为他是博索纳罗的支持者。

sentences.en: And, you know, that was kind of the note that we were originally going to end this update on.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这本来是我们最初打算结束这次更新的基调。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then, you know, right around that time, we were wrapping up this, the January 8th riots happened.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，就在那时，我们正要结束这期节目，1月8日的骚乱发生了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And obviously, that's like a huge story that is way more important than the story of the jersey.
sentences.zh: 显然，那是一个巨大的新闻，比球衣的故事重要得多。

sentences.en: And there's so many different angles that we're not going to get into.
sentences.zh: 而且有很多不同的角度我们不会深入探讨。

sentences.en: But for the purposes of this episode,
sentences.zh: 但为了这期节目的目的，

sentences.en: I wanted to call Fernando back just to sort of check in with him and see how he was feeling about the jersey and about everything that was going on.
sentences.zh: 我想再次联系费尔南多，了解一下他的近况，看看他对球衣和正在发生的一切有什么感受。

sentences.en: Well, what a difference a couple of weeks make, right?
sentences.zh: 好吧，几周的时间带来的变化真是太大了，对吧？

sentences.en: We thought that after the World Cup, there would be some reconciliation.
sentences.zh: 我们以为世界杯之后会有一些和解。

sentences.en: But no.
sentences.zh: 但并没有。

sentences.en: I think that the situation is actually worse now than he was before the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在的情况实际上比世界杯前还要糟糕。

sentences.en: Fernando says that he certainly is not going to be wearing that new yellow jersey that he bought anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 费尔南多说，他肯定不会在近期穿上他买的那件新黄色球衣了。

sentences.en: You know, it's going back in the closet.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它又要回到衣柜里去了。

sentences.en: You know, I think a lot of people will refrain from being seen in any yellow shirt because of what happened.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想很多人会因为发生的事情而避免穿任何黄色衬衫。

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想这说得通。

sentences.en: I asked Fernando what he thought was going to happen next with the jersey.
sentences.zh: 我问费尔南多他认为接下来球衣会发生什么。

sentences.en: And, I mean, I honestly was pretty surprised by his answer.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，我真的对他的回答感到相当惊讶。

sentences.en: I mean, first of all, he doesn't know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，首先，他不知道。

sentences.en: He has no idea what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 他完全不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: But he says it's conceivable that the country could abandon the yellow jersey.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，这个国家放弃黄色球衣是可以想象的。

sentences.en: Maybe this is the point where we depart from the yellow one.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是我们告别黄色球衣的时刻。

sentences.en: I think it's difficult to say now, oh, yes, definitely something's going to change.
sentences.zh: 我想现在很难说，哦，是的，肯定会有什么改变。

sentences.en: But clearly something has to happen.
sentences.zh: 但显然必须发生点什么。

sentences.en: In regards to disassociation with the far right.
sentences.zh: 关于与极右翼的脱钩。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I mean, is that something that you think could actually happen?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你认为这真的可能发生吗？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, even before the World Cup, there was some talk of turning away from the yellow jersey.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，甚至在世界杯之前，就有一些关于放弃黄色球衣的讨论。

sentences.en: From people on the left who felt that it was just too far gone as a symbol.
sentences.zh: 来自那些认为它作为一种象征已经无可救药的左翼人士。

sentences.en: That movement always felt like a long shot.
sentences.zh: 那种运动一直感觉希望渺茫。

sentences.en: But now, after January 8th, Fernando is not so sure.
sentences.zh: 但现在，在1月8日之后，费尔南多也不确定了。

sentences.en: It's not totally ridiculous to think that they might change the color of the shirt.
sentences.zh: 认为他们可能会改变球衣颜色并非完全荒谬。

sentences.en: There are rumors in Brazil that the Brazilian Football Confederation and Nike are to discuss what to do.
sentences.zh: 巴西有传言称，巴西足协和耐克将讨论该怎么做。

sentences.en: Because, clearly, the product's tarnished, right?
sentences.zh: 因为，显然，这个产品已经被玷污了，对吧？

sentences.en: Imagine if you're Nike, you're paying gazillions of dollars for the right to produce something that now has got a bad reputation.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，如果你是耐克，你花了数不清的钱来获得生产某种现在名声不好的东西的权利。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Or a bad reputation for some.
sentences.zh: 或者对某些人来说名声不好。

sentences.en: It's really fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这真的很迷人。

sentences.en: I mean, if they were to move away from the yellow jersey, isn't that just kind of like letting one side win this debate?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果他们真的放弃黄色球衣，那不就像是让辩论的一方赢了吗？

sentences.en: You know, like, it just feels like a sad outcome.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这感觉就像是一个悲伤的结果。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, I get that.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，我明白。

sentences.en: I feel kind of similarly, I think.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我也差不多，我想。

sentences.en: And I think Fernando feels that way, too.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为费尔南多也这么觉得。

sentences.en: Honestly, he seemed pretty unsure of what he thinks should happen next.
sentences.zh: 老实说，他似乎对自己认为接下来应该发生什么感到非常不确定。

sentences.en: And I get it.
sentences.zh: 我理解。

sentences.en: I mean, I think if you're a Brazilian soccer fan who doesn't support Bolsonaro or who certainly doesn't support the insurrection,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为如果你是一个不支持博索纳罗，或者肯定不支持叛乱的巴西足球迷，

sentences.en: I don't know if there's a great solution here.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这里是否有一个完美的解决方案。

sentences.en: So if they were to change the jersey, what do you think they would change it to?
sentences.zh: 那么如果他们要更换球衣，你认为他们会换成什么颜色？

sentences.en: Well, there are a few options.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有几个选择。

sentences.en: Brazil has an alternate blue kit that they've been wearing for years.
sentences.zh: 巴西有一套蓝色的客场球衣，他们已经穿了很多年了。

sentences.en: It looks pretty nice.
sentences.zh: 看起来很不错。

sentences.en: And then they could always go back to white.
sentences.zh: 而且他们总是可以回到白色。

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: White is the color of peace.
sentences.zh: 白色是和平的颜色。

sentences.en: And it's a New Year's tradition in Brazil to wear white underwear or white gloves if you want peace in the New Year.
sentences.zh: 在巴西，新年穿白色内衣或戴白色手套以祈求新年和平是一个传统。

sentences.en: So maybe this is a way to kind of like wish for something different.
sentences.zh: 所以也许这是一种祈求不同事物的方式。

sentences.en: Wow, that would really bring it all full circle.
sentences.zh: 哇，那真的会让一切回到原点。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't know how likely that is, given the history.
sentences.zh: 是的，考虑到历史，我不知道这有多大可能。

sentences.en: I mean, I think, you know, if I had to say, I think the most likely outcome is probably that the yellow jersey continues and people just keep fighting about what it means.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想，你知道，如果非要我说，我认为最可能的结果可能是黄色球衣继续存在，人们继续为它的含义而争吵。

sentences.en: But there's really no doubt that that real damage has been done to the jersey as this symbol of Brazilian unity.
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，作为巴西团结的象征，这件球衣确实受到了真正的损害。

sentences.en: You have to watch the space.
sentences.zh: 你必须密切关注事态发展。

sentences.en: But clearly something something happened.
sentences.zh: 但显然发生了一些事情。

sentences.en: And, you know, the the the perception of that shirt worldwide has been punished somehow.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，全世界对那件球衣的看法在某种程度上受到了惩罚。

sentences.en: That is undeniable.
sentences.zh: 这是不可否认的。
